The fun soon ends when police and the cranky, fast-talking Madea (Tyler Perry) arrive to crash the party. Unhappy with this sudden turn of events, the vengeful collegians decide to scare Madea and her cronies with a series of pranks. As the hours drag on, Jones and Smokey experience the gamut of urban life, complete with crackheads, shoot-outs and overly sexual pastors, concentrated into one single, unbelievable Friday.

programme.desc: Following the Battle of Antietam, Col. programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

programme.title: Blair Witch
programme.desc: A young man and his friends venture into the Black Hills Forest in Maryland to uncover the mystery surrounding his missing sister. Many believe her disappearance 17 years earlier is connected to the legend of the Blair Witch. At first the group is hopeful, especially when two locals act as guides through the dark and winding woods. As the night wears on, a visit from a menacing presence soon makes them realize that the legend is all too real, and more sinister than they could have ever imagined.

programme.title: Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2
programme.desc: As it follows the twisted path traveled by five people fixated on "The Blair Witch Project," "Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2" journeys into a dark and dangerous place where the line between truth and fiction blurs and perhaps vanishes altogether. Individual perception grows increasingly untrustworthy as the film's protagonists find themselves caught in a vortex of unspeakable evil, the origins of which -- human or supernatural -- remain chillingly uncertain.

programme.title: Walk the Line
programme.desc: The rise of country music legend Johnny Cash (Joaquin Phoenix) begins with his days as a boy growing up on the family farm, where he struggles under the scorn of his father (Robert Patrick). As the years pass, Cash ends up in Memphis, Tenn., with his wife, Vivian (Ginnifer Goodwin), and breaks into the music scene after finding his trademark sound. While on tour, Cash meets the love of his life, singer June Carter (Reese Witherspoon), but Cash's volatile lifestyle threatens to keep them apart.

programme.title: The Greatest Showman
programme.desc: Growing up in the early 1800s, P.T. Barnum displays a natural talent for publicity and promotion, selling lottery tickets by age 12. After trying his hands at various jobs, P.T. turns to show business to indulge his limitless imagination, rising from nothing to create the Barnum & Bailey circus. Featuring catchy musical numbers, exotic performers and daring acrobatic feats, Barnum's mesmerizing spectacle soon takes the world by storm to become the greatest show on Earth.

programme.title: Ocean's 11
programme.desc: Danny Ocean (Frank Sinatra) calls on some of his World War II buddies -- including Jimmy Foster (Peter Lawford), Sam Harmon (Dean Martin) and Josh Howard (Sammy Davis Jr.) -- to pull off an elaborate New Year's Eve heist at five casinos in Las Vegas. Eleven members of Danny's crew come together to pull off a perfect robbery, but they suffer a series of setbacks when Duke Santos (Cesar Romero), a former gangster, tries to thwart Ocean's plans to disappear with the money.

programme.title: Ocean's Eleven
programme.desc: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history.

programme.title: Ocean's Twelve
programme.desc: After successfully robbing five casinos in one night, Danny Ocean and his crew of thieves have big problems. Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history, the members of the gang have already spent much of the money they stole. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Ocean return the money, plus millions more in interest. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Europe.

programme.title: Ocean's Thirteen
programme.desc: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties.

programme.title: A Good Day to Die Hard
programme.desc: New York City cop John McClane (Bruce Willis) arrives in Moscow to track down his estranged son, Jack (Jai Courtney). McClane thinks his son is a criminal, so it comes as a shock when he learns that Jack is actually working undercover to protect Komarov (Sebastian Koch), a Russian government whistleblower. With their own lives on the line, McClane and Jack must overcome their differences in order to get Komarov to safety and thwart a potentially disastrous crime in the Chernobyl region.

programme.title: The Hangover Part II
programme.desc: Two years after the disastrous events in Las Vegas, it is now Stu's (Ed Helms) turn to walk down the aisle. Since his bride is from Thailand, Stu decides to hold the wedding there. Desperately hoping to avoid the mayhem of Doug's (Justin Bartha) bachelor party, Stu chooses what he thinks will be a safe option: an alcohol-free, pre-wedding brunch. But this being Thailand, and with Phil (Bradley Cooper) and Alan (Zach Galifianakis) again in attendance, anything can happen.

programme.title: Game Night
programme.desc: Max and Annie's weekly game night gets kicked up a notch when Max's brother Brooks arranges a murder mystery party -- complete with fake thugs and federal agents. So when Brooks gets kidnapped, it's all supposed to be part of the game. As the competitors set out to solve the case, they start to learn that neither the game nor Brooks are what they seem to be. The friends soon find themselves in over their heads as each twist leads to another unexpected turn over the course of one chaotic night.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Having witnessed his parents' brutal murder as a child, millionaire philanthropist Bruce Wayne (Michael Keaton) fights crime in Gotham City disguised as Batman, a costumed hero who strikes fear into the hearts of villains. But when a deformed madman who calls himself The Joker (Jack Nicholson) seizes control of Gotham's criminal underworld, Batman must face his most ruthless nemesis ever while protecting both his identity and his love interest, reporter Vicki Vale (Kim Basinger).

programme.title: Batman Returns
programme.desc: The monstrous Penguin (Danny DeVito), who lives in the sewers beneath Gotham, joins up with wicked shock-headed businessman Max Shreck (Christopher Walken) to topple the Batman (Michael Keaton) once and for all. But when Shreck's timid assistant, Selina Kyle (Michelle Pfeiffer), finds out, and Shreck tries to kill her, she is transformed into the sexy Catwoman. She teams up with the Penguin and Shreck to destroy Batman, but sparks fly unexpectedly when she confronts the caped crusader.

programme.title: Batman Forever
programme.desc: Batman (Val Kilmer) faces off against two foes: the schizophrenic, horribly scarred former District Attorney Harvey Dent, aka Two-Face (Tommy Lee Jones), and the Riddler (Jim Carrey), a disgruntled ex-Wayne Enterprises inventor seeking revenge against his former employer by unleashing his brain-sucking weapon on Gotham City's residents. As the caped crusader also deals with tortured memories of his parents' murder, he has a new romance, with psychologist Chase Meridian (Nicole Kidman).

programme.title: Batman & Robin
programme.desc: This superhero adventure finds Batman (George Clooney) and his partner, Robin (Chris O'Donnell), attempting to the foil the sinister schemes of a deranged set of new villains, most notably the melancholy Mr. Freeze (Arnold Schwarzenegger), who wants to make Gotham into an arctic region, and the sultry Poison Ivy (Uma Thurman), a plant-loving femme fatale. As the Dynamic Duo contends with these bad guys, a third hero, Batgirl (Alicia Silverstone), joins the ranks of the city's crime-fighters.

programme.title: Joker
programme.desc: Forever alone in a crowd, failed comedian Arthur Fleck seeks connection as he walks the streets of Gotham City. Arthur wears two masks -- the one he paints for his day job as a clown, and the guise he projects in a futile attempt to feel like he's part of the world around him. Isolated, bullied and disregarded by society, Fleck begins a slow descent into madness as he transforms into the criminal mastermind known as the Joker.

programme.title: Rodan
programme.desc: A bug-eating pterodactyl flies out of a coal mine and wrecks Japan with sonic booms.

programme.title: Reframed: Next Gen Narratives - A Star Is Born
programme.desc: Clover must leave her family behind to compete in an algorithm-based singing competition; pressure from the judges leads Clover to doubt herself, but her family's words give her the strength to perform.

programme.title: Reframed: Next Gen Narratives - The Prince and the Pauper
programme.desc: Trapped in a bizarre, bureaucratic afterlife, a famous Mohawk ghost is drawn into an encounter with an identical and partially-deceased descendant.

programme.title: Talk Black
programme.desc: A timid engineer develops a wild and expressive split personality that helps her stand up to male co-workers.

programme.title: Fantastic Planet
programme.desc: This animated tale follows the relationship between the small human-like Oms and their much larger blue-skinned oppressors, the Draags, who rule the planet of Ygam. While the Draags have long kept Oms as illiterate pets, this hierarchy shifts after an Om boy becomes educated, thanks to a young female Draag. This leads to an Om rebellion, which weakens the Draag control over their race. Will the Oms and the Draags find a way to coexist? Or will they destroy each other?

programme.title: Mothra vs. Godzilla
programme.desc: Japan comes under attack from two monsters in a giant monster battle between a rampaging Godzilla and the colossal genetically engineered moth called Mothra.

programme.title: Godzilla vs. Gigan
programme.desc: Godzilla and Anguirus fight three-headed dragon Ghidorah and huge bird Gigan at a cartoonist's theme park.

programme.title: Godzilla vs. Megalon
programme.desc: Godzilla and flying cyborg Jet Jaguar meet a giant cockroach and a big black chicken sent by Seatopians.

programme.title: Godzilla vs. Mechagodzilla
programme.desc: An Okinawan monster-god helps Godzilla defeat his bionic double.

programme.title: Head Office
programme.desc: A U.S. senator's son (Judge Reinhold) gets a job at a conglomerate and falls for the chairman's (Eddie Albert) radical daughter.

programme.title: Rodan
programme.desc: A bug-eating pterodactyl flies out of a coal mine and wrecks Japan with sonic booms.

programme.title: The Hobbit
programme.desc: An animated adaptation of J.R.R. Tolkien's tale of the adventures of a hobbit on a quest to regain a dwarf king's gold.

programme.title: Dim Sum Funeral
programme.desc: In the wake of her death, the embittered children of Chinese-American matriarch Mrs. Xiao (Lisa Lu) begrudgingly return to their childhood home for a bristly -- and brief, they hope -- reunion. But after Xiao's maid and sole confidant, Viola (Talia Shire), reveals her wish to undergo a week-long Buddhist funeral rite, the younger Xiaos -- including plastic surgeon Alexander (Russell Wong) and lesbian actress Meimei (Steph Song) -- have seven days to come to terms with her death, and each other.

programme.title: War for the Planet of the Apes
programme.desc: Caesar (Andy Serkis) and his apes are forced into a deadly conflict with an army of humans led by a ruthless colonel (Woody Harrelson). After the apes suffer unimaginable losses, Caesar wrestles with his darker instincts and begins his own mythic quest to avenge his kind. As the journey finally brings them face to face, Caesar and the colonel are pitted against each other in an epic battle that will determine the fate of both of their species and the future of the planet.

programme.title: The Way, Way Back
programme.desc: Duncan (Liam James) is an awkward teen who must spend the summer at a beach house with his mother (Toni Collette), her boyfriend, Trent (Steve Carell), and Trent's obnoxious daughter. Trent can't resist badgering Duncan, so the youth steals away to a water park and gets a job that will help him stay off Trent's radar. As Duncan tends to the slides and pools of the aging park, he finds a father figure in wisecracking park manager Owen (Sam Rockwell) at a time when he desperately needs one.

programme.title: My Big Fat Greek Wedding
programme.desc: Everyone in the Portokalos family worries about Toula (Nia Vardalos). Still unmarried at 30 years old, she works at Dancing Zorba's, the Greek restaurant owned by her parents, Gus (Michael Constantine) and Maria (Lainie Kazan). After taking a job at her aunt's travel agency, she falls in love with Ian Miller (John Corbett), a teacher who is tall, handsome and definitely not Greek. Toula isn't sure which will be more upsetting to her father, that Ian is a foreigner or that he's a vegetarian.

programme.title: Smoking Tigers
programme.desc: Lonely 16-year-old Korean American Hayoung tries to hide her problematic family and lower-income background from her new wealthy friends.

programme.title: Nanny McPhee Returns
programme.desc: Enigmatic Nanny McPhee arrives on the doorstep of a harried mother, Isabel Green, who is trying to raise her kids and tend to the family farm while her husband is away at war. Isabel has her hands full of not only her own three, but also with her sister's spoiled pair. With no time to lose, McPhee uses magic to instill in the children five important lessons.

programme.title: Shazam!
programme.desc: We all have a superhero inside of us -- it just takes a bit of magic to bring it out. In 14-year-old Billy Batson's case, all he needs to do is shout out one word to transform into the adult superhero Shazam. Still a kid at heart, Shazam revels in the new version of himself by doing what any other teen would do -- have fun while testing out his newfound powers. But he'll need to master them quickly before the evil Dr. Thaddeus Sivana can get his hands on Shazam's magical abilities.

programme.title: Shazam! Fury of the Gods
programme.desc: Bestowed with the powers of the gods, Billy Batson and his fellow foster kids are still learning how to juggle teenage life with their adult superhero alter egos. When a vengeful trio of ancient gods arrives on Earth in search of the magic stolen from them long ago, Shazam and his allies get thrust into a battle for their superpowers, their lives, and the fate of the world.

programme.title: Robin Hood
programme.desc: After the death of Richard the Lion-Hearted, a skilled archer named Robin Longstride travels to Nottingham, where villagers suffer under a despotic sheriff and crippling taxation. He meets and falls in love with a spirited widow, Marion, although she is skeptical of his motives. Hoping to win her heart and save the village, Robin gathers a band of warriors to fight corruption in Nottingham, little knowing they will soon be fighting to save England itself.

programme.title: Rampage
programme.desc: Primatologist Davis Okoye shares an unshakable bond with George, an extraordinarily intelligent, silverback gorilla that's been in his care since birth. When a rogue genetic experiment goes wrong, it causes George, a wolf and a reptile to grow to a monstrous size. As the mutated beasts embark on a path of destruction, Okoye teams up with a discredited genetic engineer and the military to secure an antidote and prevent a global catastrophe.

programme.title: A Clockwork Orange
programme.desc: In an England of the future, Alex and his "Droogs" spend their nights getting high at the Korova Milkbar before embarking on "a little of the old ultraviolence," while jauntily warbling "Singin' in the Rain." After he's jailed for bludgeoning the Cat Lady to death, Alex submits to behavior modification technique to earn his freedom; he's conditioned to abhor violence. Returned to the world defenseless, Alex becomes the victim of his prior victims.

programme.title: The Blair Witch Project
programme.desc: Found video footage tells the tale of three film students (Heather Donahue, Joshua Leonard, Michael C. Williams) who've traveled to a small town to collect documentary footage about the Blair Witch, a legendary local murderer. Over the course of several days, the students interview townspeople and gather clues to support the tale's veracity. But the project takes a frightening turn when the students lose their way in the woods and begin hearing horrific noises.

programme.title: Blair Witch
programme.desc: A young man and his friends venture into the Black Hills Forest in Maryland to uncover the mystery surrounding his missing sister. Many believe her disappearance 17 years earlier is connected to the legend of the Blair Witch. At first the group is hopeful, especially when two locals act as guides through the dark and winding woods. As the night wears on, a visit from a menacing presence soon makes them realize that the legend is all too real, and more sinister than they could have ever imagined.

programme.title: Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2
programme.desc: As it follows the twisted path traveled by five people fixated on "The Blair Witch Project," "Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2" journeys into a dark and dangerous place where the line between truth and fiction blurs and perhaps vanishes altogether. Individual perception grows increasingly untrustworthy as the film's protagonists find themselves caught in a vortex of unspeakable evil, the origins of which -- human or supernatural -- remain chillingly uncertain.

programme.title: Walk the Line
programme.desc: The rise of country music legend Johnny Cash (Joaquin Phoenix) begins with his days as a boy growing up on the family farm, where he struggles under the scorn of his father (Robert Patrick). As the years pass, Cash ends up in Memphis, Tenn., with his wife, Vivian (Ginnifer Goodwin), and breaks into the music scene after finding his trademark sound. While on tour, Cash meets the love of his life, singer June Carter (Reese Witherspoon), but Cash's volatile lifestyle threatens to keep them apart.

programme.title: The Greatest Showman
programme.desc: Growing up in the early 1800s, P.T. Barnum displays a natural talent for publicity and promotion, selling lottery tickets by age 12. After trying his hands at various jobs, P.T. turns to show business to indulge his limitless imagination, rising from nothing to create the Barnum & Bailey circus. Featuring catchy musical numbers, exotic performers and daring acrobatic feats, Barnum's mesmerizing spectacle soon takes the world by storm to become the greatest show on Earth.

programme.title: Ocean's 11
programme.desc: Danny Ocean (Frank Sinatra) calls on some of his World War II buddies -- including Jimmy Foster (Peter Lawford), Sam Harmon (Dean Martin) and Josh Howard (Sammy Davis Jr.) -- to pull off an elaborate New Year's Eve heist at five casinos in Las Vegas. Eleven members of Danny's crew come together to pull off a perfect robbery, but they suffer a series of setbacks when Duke Santos (Cesar Romero), a former gangster, tries to thwart Ocean's plans to disappear with the money.

programme.title: Ocean's Eleven
programme.desc: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history.

programme.title: Ocean's Twelve
programme.desc: After successfully robbing five casinos in one night, Danny Ocean and his crew of thieves have big problems. Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history, the members of the gang have already spent much of the money they stole. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Ocean return the money, plus millions more in interest. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Europe.

programme.title: Southland Tales
programme.desc: En un futuro distópico, los destinos de cuatro personas se entrelazan con los de toda la humanidad cuando una nueva tecnología amenaza con destruir el mundo.

programme.title: Planet Action
programme.desc: Un espacio único que reúne los detrás de cámaras de las películas de acción más relevantes de Hollywood.

programme.title: Dragon Wars
programme.desc: Ethan Kendrick (Jason Behr) descubre que unas criaturas antiguas llamadas Imoogi han regresado a la Tierra, y la única forma de detenerlas es con la ayuda de Sarah (Amanda Brooks). Basada en una leyenda coreana.

programme.title: Absolute Deception
programme.desc: Una periodista hace equipo con un agente federal para descubrir la verdad detrás de la muerte de su esposo.

programme.title: Blue Streak
programme.desc: Un ladrón en libertad condicional se hace pasar por policía para recuperar un diamante que escondió en una estación policíaca.

programme.title: Death at a Funeral
programme.desc: Prepararse para un funeral no es nada agradable. Aarón tiene el peor día de su vida cuando trata de dar a su difunto padre un merecido funeral, pero amigos y familiares provocan un caos.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective
programme.desc: Un detective de poca monta descubre algo más que un simple secuestro en su búsqueda de la mascota desaparecida de los Miami Dolphins.

programme.title: Big Daddy
programme.desc: Un irresponsable neoyorquino trata de darle estabilidad a su vida al adoptar a un niño rebelde de cinco años.

programme.title: The Social Network
programme.desc: Mark Zuckerberg, un estudiante de Harvard, crea la red social que terminará convirtiéndose en Facebook, pero recibe acusaciones del cofundador y de dos hermanos que sostienen que la idea fue suya.

programme.title: Jerry Maguire
programme.desc: Jerry Maguire, agente deportivo, pierde su empleo y debe reinventar su carrera profesional con solo dos aliados: un futbolista de segunda categoría y una secretaria, madre soltera.

programme.title: Swept Away
programme.desc: Imagine being shipwrecked on a beautiful island -- with someone you really can't stand. A young soldier (Adriano Giannini) is cast adrift on an island with his employer, a rich, self-centered woman who is used to having her own way. Cut off from society, he reverses their roles, stripping her of pride and vanity and controlling her completely. Until, that is, she falls in love with him.

programme.title: Crazy in Alabama
programme.desc: In 1965, eccentric Lucille Vinson murders her abusive husband, chops off his head and flees to Hollywood to pursue television fame. Back in her Alabama hometown, nephew Peejoe Bullis witnesses the killing of a young black man by racist sheriff John Doggett and is unsure whether he should testify against him. When the law catches up with Lucille, she returns home, where Peejoe is becoming increasingly involved with the civil rights movement.

programme.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

programme.title: The Mask of Zorro
programme.desc: After being imprisoned for 20 years, Zorro -- Don Diego de la Vega (Anthony Hopkins) -- receives word that his old enemy, Don Rafael Montero (Stuart Wilson), has returned. Don Diego escapes and returns to his old headquarters, where he trains aimless drunk Alejandro Murrieta (Antonio Banderas) to be his successor. Meanwhile, Montero -- who has secretly raised Diego's daughter, Elena (Catherine Zeta-Jones), as his own -- hatches a plot to rob California of its gold.

programme.title: The Legend of Zorro
programme.desc: A secret society, the Knights of Aragon, seeks to keep the United States from achieving manifest destiny -- and only the legendary Zorro (Antonio Banderas) can stop them. Unfortunately, Zorro, also known as Don Alejandro de la Vega, has problems of his own: His wife, Elena (Catherine Zeta-Jones), is divorcing him for spending too much time pursuing heroics and not enough being a father to their young son. But it isn't long before the whole family gets caught up in stopping the Knights.

programme.title: Last Action Hero
programme.desc: Following the death of his father, young Danny Madigan (Austin O'Brien) takes comfort in watching action movies featuring the indestructible Los Angeles cop Jack Slater (Arnold Schwarzenegger). After being given a magic ticket by theater manager Nick (Robert Prosky), Danny is sucked into the screen and bonds with Slater. When evil fictional villain Benedict (Charles Dance) gets his hands on the ticket and enters the real world, Danny and Jack must follow and stop him.

programme.title: The Green Hornet
programme.desc: Britt Reid (Seth Rogen), the heir to the largest newspaper fortune in Los Angeles, is a spoiled playboy who has been, thus far, happy to lead an aimless life. After his father (Tom Wilkinson) dies, Britt meets Kato (Jay Chou), a resourceful company employee. Realizing that they have the talent and resources to make something of their lives, Britt and Kato join forces as costumed crime-fighters to bring down the city's most-powerful criminal, Chudnofsky (Christoph Waltz).

programme.title: McLintock!
programme.desc: Aging rancher George Washington McLintock, a wealthy self-made man, is forced to deal with numerous personal and professional problems. Seemingly everyone wants a piece of his enormous farmstead, including high-ranking government men, McLintock's own sons and nearby Native Americans. As McLintock tries to juggle his various adversaries, his wife, who left him two years previously, suddenly returns. But she isn't interested in her husband -- she wants custody of their daughter.

programme.title: There Was a Crooked Man
programme.desc: After a botched heist, Wild West bandit Paris Pitman Jr. (Kirk Douglas) hides his newly stolen money where no one will find it, then loses his entire gang in a blaze of bullets before being captured by the law and given a lengthy sentence in a desert jail. Paris believes that he can buy his way out of his predicament by offering some cash to the guards, but the upstanding Sheriff Lopeman (Henry Fonda) makes sure his men remain honest. Running out of options, Paris begins plotting a jailbreak.

programme.title: Leanne Morgan: So Yummy
programme.desc: Leanne Morgan gives an honest look at suburban life and the challenges of keeping her husband happy while juggling kids, dogs, and cheerleading camp.

programme.desc: Kate is missing as a big convention is meeting to decide where to hold their convention, she is stuck in a cave.

programme.desc: With Kate injured, Uncle Joe and the daughters must corner the convention.

programme.title: Petticoat Junction - The Genghis Keane Story
programme.desc: Kate is surprised at her old school teacher's new personality.

programme.desc: A bite-sized taste of country lifestyle, Southern travel, artist interviews and down-home food.

programme.title: Petticoat Junction - The Genghis Keane Story

programme.title: Bonanza - San Francisco
programme.desc: Shortly after the Ponderosa cattle herd arrives in San Francisco at the hands of Hoss, Joe and Ben, two of their trail drivers are shanghaied and destined for Hong Kong.

programme.title: Bonanza - Bitter Water
programme.desc: When a neighbor agrees to sell his property, the Cartwrights fear the loss of water rights for their cattle.

programme.title: Bonanza - Feet of Clay
programme.desc: The Cartwrights befriend a boy whose father has been sent to jail and whose mother has recently died.

programme.title: Bonanza - Dark Star
programme.desc: Little Joe falls for a girl who has been disowned by her people because they think she is a witch and, therefore, an outcast.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies - Jed Becomes a Banker
programme.desc: Jed is promoted to the position of bank vice president in order for him to participate in an interbank skeet shoot.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies - The Family Tree
programme.desc: An authority on American history finds evidence that Jed's ancestors preceded the Mayflower to America.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies - Jed Cuts the Family Tree
programme.desc: Cousin Pearl gets a glamour treatment and tries to groom the Clampetts for high society.

programme.title: Petticoat Junction - Please Buy My Violets
programme.desc: Uncle Joe decides to go into the cologne business.

programme.title: Petticoat Junction - The Ringer
programme.desc: Betty Jo becomes the first female contestant in the horseshoe tournament.

programme.title: The Andy Griffith Show - A Wife for Andy
programme.desc: Barney thinks it's time Andy got married, but Andy has a plan of his own.

programme.title: The Andy Griffith Show - Dogs, Dogs, Dogs
programme.desc: A pack of hunting dogs overruns the Mayberry courthouse just as Andy is trying to impress a state official.

programme.title: The Hellbenders
programme.desc: The Civil War is over, and the South has fallen, but Col. Jonas (Joseph Cotten) has a plan to revive the Confederacy. He raids a Union Army detail and walks away with valuable treasure that he intends to put to use raising another rebel army. Jonas needs to keep the treasure safe during shipment, so he places it in a coffin and forces saloon girl Claire (Norma Bengell) to play widow. Claire is unwilling to do her part, however, and puts herself in danger by opposing the dangerous Jonas.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphonie Nr. 8
programme.desc: Mahlers 8. Symphonie, auch bekannt als die Symphonie der Tausend, ist ein monumentales Chor-Epos aus dem Jahr 1906, das ein riesiges Ensemble aus Solisten, Chören und einem gewaltigen Orchester erfordert.

programme.title: Beethoven - Streichquartette Nr. 2, 14 und 16
programme.desc: Das Quatuor Ébène präsentiert in der Philharmonie de Paris Meisterwerke aus Beethovens Streichquartettrepertoire. Zum Jubiläum des Komponisten spielt das renommierte französische Ensemble die Streichquartette Nr. 2, 14 und 16.

programme.title: Wer hat das Boléro von Maurice Ravel gestohlen?
programme.desc: In der Dokumentation wird der Rechtsstreit um das Musikstück Boléro untersucht. Das Stück wird von Maurice Ravel im Jahr 1928 komponiert und dieser gibt die Rechte an seinen Bruder Edouard. Dieser stirbt 1960 und löst den Rechtsstreit aus.

programme.title: Martha Argerich - Eine Geburtstagsfeier - III
programme.desc: Anlässlich ihres 80. Geburtstags widmet sich die argentinische Pianistin Martha Argerich dem Kammermusikrepertoire in einem wunderbaren Konzert. Die "Grande Dame des Klaviers" wird von verschiedenen renommierten Künstlern begleitet.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 8 in F major, Op. 93
programme.desc: Philippe Jordan dirigiert das Orchester de l'Opéra national de Paris in Beethovens Symphonie Nr. 8. Gespielt wird die Symphonie in F-Dur Op. 93, welche in den Jahren 1812 und 1813 geschrieben wurde und im Jahr 1814 ihre Erstaufführung feierte.

programme.title: Hommage an Hans van Manen
programme.desc: Der Sender bietet Ihnen diese Hommage an Hans van Manen mit dem niederländischen Nationalballett.

programme.title: Klavierduette - Mozart, Ravel, Rachmaninoff u. a
programme.desc: In diesem prächtigen Konzert vereinen sich zwei außergewöhnliche russische Pianisten, Nikolay Lugansky und Vadim Rudenko. Diese Aufführung wurde am 25. November 2021 in der Tschaikowski-Konzerthalle in Moskau, Russland, aufgezeichnet.

programme.title: Gaming X Symphony: Legends & Quests in Concert
programme.desc: Das Dänische nationale Symphonieorchester spielt beliebte Kompositionen von legendären Videospielen. Mit dabei sind Melodien aus "The Legend of Zelda", "League of Legends", "Halo", "World of Warcraft" und vielen weiteren Videospielklassikern.

programme.title: Schumann - 3. Klaviersonate, Op. 14
programme.desc: Der Pianist Riccardo Schwartz spielt die dritte Klaviersonate, Op. 14 von Robert Schumann.

programme.title: Schubert - Rosamunde Ouvertüre (D. 644)
programme.desc: Andreas Spering dirigiert die Philharmonie Zuidnederland in einer Aufführung in Eindhoven 2015.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern.

programme.title: Eve - Worst First Date Ever
programme.desc: Friends of a young woman (Eve) provide perspectives on male/female relationships; Shelly finds herself drawn to J.T. (Jason George) during a night out with her friends.

programme.title: Eve - Condom Mania
programme.desc: Janie gives Shelly relationship advice after spying a box of condoms in J.T.'s shopping cart.

programme.title: Eve - She Snoops to Conquer
programme.desc: Shelly resorts to snooping through J.T.'s stuff to get to know him better; Donovan sends Nick to the best tattoo artist (DMX) in Miami.

programme.title: Eve - The Talk
programme.desc: J.T. and Shelly talk about dating exclusively after a party stirs up jealousy. Carmen Electra, Corey Reynolds and Julio Iglesias Jr. guest star.

programme.desc: Tamar and Ms. E hit the kitchen to whip up a mouthwatering family dinner from scratch. On the menu: sticky, slow-cooked BBQ ribs, creamy mashed sweet potatoes and savory Brussels sprouts tossed with crispy bacon.

programme.title: Cooking Sessions with Tamar & Ms. E - Ladies Love Lemon
programme.desc: Tamar and Ms. E are turning sour into sweet with a vibrant, lemon-infused feast. The duo brightens up the kitchen with zesty lemon chicken orzo, sautéed lemon broccolini, and a warm blueberry lemon dump cake.

programme.title: Living by Design - TCara & Zack
programme.desc: Revamping TCara and Zacks' bedroom into a serene retreat; adding textured wall panels and custom shelving for depth; completing the transformation with soft colors, elegant curtains and stylish furniture for the space.

programme.title: Living by Design - Melissa and Brandon
programme.desc: This busy couple wants the family room revamped for friends and family. Jake makes a custom table, while Jazz adds art, throw pillows and a new light fixture. The reveal meal is pasta with crab sauce & snicker doodle cupcakes.

programme.title: The Parkers - Make a Joyful Noise
programme.desc: Kim leaves the church choir to join a funky gospel group, but Nikki fills the void by discovering a brilliant new talent.

programme.title: The Parkers - It's Showtime

programme.desc: Professor Oglevee turns to Nikki for comfort following a career setback.

She prides herself in being "just one of the boys" and is horrified at the idea of becoming a girly girl.

Eventually, he falls in love with her and must win her over before she gets married.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible -- Fallout

Arms dealer John Lark and a group of terrorists known as the Apostles plan to use three plutonium cores for a simultaneous nuclear attack on the Vatican, Jerusalem and Mecca, Saudi Arabia. When the weapons go missing, Ethan and his crew find themselves in a desperate race against time to prevent them from falling into the wrong hands.

programme.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home

When Peter asks for help from Doctor Strange, the stakes become even more dangerous, forcing him to discover what it truly means to be Spider-Man.

programme.title: All About Eve
programme.desc: Backstage story revolving around aspiring actress Eve Harrington. Tattered and forlorn, Eve shows up in the dressing room of Broadway mega-star Margo Channing, telling a melancholy life story to Margo and her friends. Margo takes Eve under her wing, and it appears that Eve is a conniver that uses Margo.

programme.title: Blood and Sand
programme.desc: Brash young Spanish peasant Juan Gallardo (Tyrone Power) aspires to follow his dead father's footsteps into the bullring, despite his mother's fears. Bidding his childhood sweetheart Carmen (Linda Darnell) farewell, Juan and his friends travel to Madrid to learn the bullfighting craft. Years later, when Juan's fame as a matador soars, he returns to Seville to marry Carmen. Soon, Juan's head is turned by the elegant temptress Doña Sol De Muira (Rita Hayworth), and his career takes a turn.

programme.title: The Black Swan
programme.desc: With the pardon of notorious pirate Henry Morgan by the English King, Caribbean pirates are offered amnesty if they give up their lawless ways. As governor of Jamaica, Morgan picks Captain Jamie Waring to round up the renegade captain Billy Leech. Beautiful Margaret Denby complicates matters for Waring, as her scorn for him is matched only by his love for her.

programme.title: The Black Rose
programme.desc: Following the 13th-century death of his nobleman father, Walter of Gurnie (Tyrone Power) and his confidant, Tristram (Jack Hawkins), join a caravan led by the North African Bayan (Orson Welles) en route to China. Along the way, the beautiful Maryam (Cecile Aubry), known as the Black Rose, begs Walter to take her to England with him. When the warlord Bayan reveals his intention to invade and subjugate China's advanced society, the trio attempt their escape back to England.

programme.title: The Lion
programme.desc: Living an idyllic existence on a Kenyan wildlife preserve, Tina (Pamela Franklin) is remarkably at home with the resident animals. In fact, she is so comfortable with the various creatures that her best friend is an adult lion. While Tina isn't too worried by this relationship, her mother, Christine (Capucine), becomes extremely concerned, and requests that her ex-husband -- Tina's father, Robert (William Holden) -- come for a visit to help straighten the girl out.

programme.title: The Book of Life
programme.desc: In the Mexican town of San Angel, Manolo (Diego Luna), Maria (Zoë Saldana) and Joaquin (Channing Tatum) have been friends ever since childhood. Although their lives have taken different paths -- Maria was sent to Europe, Joaquin joined the military, and Manolo studied to become a bullfighter -- one thing remains the same: Manolo and Joaquin both want to marry Maria. Little does the trio know that battling husband-and-wife deities have made a high-stakes wager on the love triangle's outcome.

programme.title: The Aftermath

As they set off for their new home, Rachael is stunned to discover that Lewis has made an unexpected decision: They will be sharing the grand house with its previous owners, a German widower and his troubled daughter. In this charged atmosphere, enmity and grief give way to passion and betrayal.

programme.desc: A young couple with three little boys and a baby girl on the way hunt for a large family home in Knoxville, Tennessee. He'd like the ease of a new build, but she loves character and is ready to bring out her DIY skills.

programme.title: House Hunters - Back in Buffalo
programme.desc: A young couple wants to be close to friends and family and looks to move from Tampa, Fla. to their hometown of Buffalo, N.Y.; she wants an older home with plenty of space to raise their future kids, but he wants a place that's smaller and updated.

programme.title: House Hunters - From Van Life to Fam Life
programme.desc: A nomadic couple looks to finally settle down with their new baby in Colorado Springs, Colo.; she's a bougie businesswoman who wants their home to reflect success, but he prefers a rustic cabin.

programme.title: House Hunters - Rich in the '90s
programme.desc: A pop culture enthusiast couple wants retro style for their first home in Kansas City, Missouri; they're looking for a place that has a '90s vibe, but finding a nostalgic home that isn't too old or in need of a major overhaul may be a challenge.

programme.title: House Hunters - Beyonce, If You're Watching This
programme.desc: A Beyonce superfan is chasing generational wealth in Maryland; he's looking for a home with rental potential and plenty of room for his Beyonce merch, but his older brother will be one of the renters, and he's all about his own comfort.

programme.title: House Hunters - Bestie Right Next to Me
programme.desc: Best friends attached at the hip are determined to find two homes right next to each other outside Dallas; finding homes for sale that are also neighboring is enough of a challenge, but their differing tastes and price ranges might make it impossible.

programme.title: House Hunters - Offbeat Appeal in Atlanta
programme.desc: A couple's moving from New Jersey to Atlanta to enjoy a more relaxed, southern vibe; it's their first home together, and she wants something stylish and up-to-date, but he's a musician who's looking for offbeat appeal.

programme.title: House Hunters - Tall Guy Goes Mile High
programme.desc: A 6'8 Gen Xer is ready to buy his first home in Denver; his practical side keeps hitting the brakes as he dreams of tall ceilings and space to work on cars, but his best friend wants him to think bigger now so he doesn't have buyer's remorse later.

programme.title: House Hunters - Roots in Ridgewood
programme.desc: A couple with two young kids is ready to put down roots in Ridgewood, New Jersey; she wants a character home with a deluxe kitchen, and he prefers something modern with no projects.

programme.title: My Lottery Dream Home - Lottery Strikes Twice
programme.desc: A Boston native knew she was lucky when she won a million, but now she scored a whopping $25 million on a scratcher.

programme.title: My Lottery Dream Home - From Big Rigs to Big Riches
programme.desc: After hitting the jackpot, an ex-servicewoman is ready to leave renting behind and search for her forever home in Greensboro, N.C.; with David and her son along for the ride, she's out to find a home to begin her next chapter.

programme.title: The Aging Brain
programme.desc: Learn what's behind mental decline with age, and how to improve memory, focus and concentration with NeuroQ's Darrin Peterson and Dale Bredesen MD.

programme.title: Mercy Ships
programme.desc: Mercy Ship's crew of world-class medical volunteers sail across the globe providing lifesaving surgeries to those with nowhere else to turn.

programme.title: See Wrinkles and Bags Vanish Instantly With GEN90!!

programme.title: Looking for a Medicare plan? Tune in now!
programme.desc: The Medicare annual election period ends on December 7th. Watch and learn about Humana Medicare Advantage plans.

programme.title: Home Town - When Life Gives You Tomatoes
programme.desc: When a couple loses out on a few homes, Ben and Erin hope that plan B is plan better; with a budding food business that requires a specialty garden on the property, the Napiers face a time crunch to create a home that delivers from the inside out.

programme.title: Home Town - Unfinished Business
programme.desc: After completing the top floor of a local architect's downtown loft, Ben and Erin return to update the second floor after a fire; Erin steps outside her comfort zone to design a modern kitchen, entertainment room, and guest suite.

programme.title: Home Town - Building Champions
programme.desc: Ben and Erin return to their alma mater, Jones College, to transform the outdated women's basketball locker room; blending nostalgic collegiate style with heart, they look to create a warm, welcoming second home for the team.

programme.title: Home Town - Unfinished Business
programme.desc: After completing the top floor of a local architect's downtown loft, Ben and Erin return to update the second floor after a fire; Erin steps outside her comfort zone to design a modern kitchen, entertainment room, and guest suite.

programme.title: Home Town - Coastal Cabin
programme.desc: After years in a tiny California home, a couple heads to Laurel with a gift from her late father that makes their first home possible; Ben and Erin now design a coastal cabin-inspired retreat, tailored to their unique need for separate bedrooms.

programme.title: Lakefront Bargain Hunt - Fishing Around Watauga Lake
programme.desc: After visiting Watauga Lake for years, a couple and their three kids are ready to buy a lakefront home to enjoy the area whenever they want; since the family's favorite activity is fishing, they want a woodsy retreat that's equipped for a boat.

programme.title: Lakefront Bargain Hunt - Counting on Carroll County
programme.desc: A Pittsburgh couple with three young children is ready for some downtime between work, school and their kids' activities. After deciding to look within a two-hour radius of their home, they discover Lake Mohawk and Atwood Lake in Carroll County, OH.

programme.title: Lakefront Bargain Hunt - Space to Entertain on the Chain
programme.desc: A couple who love bringing their kids to the Chain O'Lakes in Illinois have always wanted to own a vacation house; now, they're looking for the right property at the right price so they can dock their boat and entertain friends in their dream home.

programme.title: Lakefront Bargain Hunt - Minnesota Homecoming
programme.desc: As Bethany and Matt raise their son, they realize that living in Chicago is just too far from their families back in Minnesota; now that they're returning to their roots, they want to find a forever home on the tranquil shores of Forest Lake.

programme.title: Lakefront Bargain Hunt - Turn Key or Fixer-upper in Ohio
programme.desc: A couple hunt for a vacation home on Apple Valley Lake to enjoy with their two boys and extended family; they hope to find a steal that gets them big lake views, but they can't decide between a turn-key property for her or a fixer-upper for him.

programme.title: Lakefront Bargain Hunt - Seeking Southern Comfort on Smith Lake
programme.desc: A couple is in search of a perfect lake house; she wants to spend extra for an open concept, updated interior with more space for company, while he wants a great dock and a low price tag.

programme.title: Lakefront Bargain Hunt - Overcoming a Limited Inventory on the Lakes of Otsego County
programme.desc: A busy New York couple want a weekend retreat by the Otsego County lake where they were married; but with a shrinking market, they're not sure if they'll be able to find a waterfront dream home at an affordable price.

programme.title: Lakefront Bargain Hunt - Many Options to Consider in the Minocqua Area
programme.desc: High school sweethearts Darci and Jim fall in love with the Minocqua area of Wisconsin on their very first visit; they hope to find an affordable waterfront home where they can enjoy nature and make memories with their family.

programme.title: Lakefront Bargain Hunt - A Bridge to Idaho's Best Kept Secret
programme.desc: A couple who love vacationing with their three kids on Idaho's sprawling Lake Pend Oreille want to find their dream home there.

programme.title: Lakefront Bargain Hunt - Boats, Bikes and Bargain on Badin Lake
programme.desc: An adventurous family loves taking their boats and jet skis out on the lake, and with a busy schedule back home, they want a vacation property to help them reconnect in Badin Lake, N.C.

programme.title: House Hunters - Ohana Means Family
programme.desc: After the death of his mother, a Maui surfer looks to be closer to family in Florida; he wants everything from fancy toilets to a perfectly square pool and after seeing 50 homes, his agent and friend is worried he'll never make the move.

programme.title: Zoo Clues
programme.desc: With all of the various animal species roaming around the planet there's a lot to know about animals, which means no one knows everything about them. Thankfully "Zoo Clues" fills in some of the blanks. Each half-hour episode investigates at least a dozen questions about animals to provide viewers with answers. Have you ever wondered if birds can fly backward, how animals without external ears hear, or why zebras have stripes? Those are among the questions waiting for answers on "Zoo Clues."

programme.title: Animal Atlas
programme.desc: This educational series takes viewers on a journey around the world to meet all kinds of animals, from the familiar to the not-so-familiar. "Animal Atlas" teaches viewers about the animals' lives, histories and adaptations that allow them to survive in their environment. Whether it's visiting monkeys or heading underwater for a look at mammals that live in the ocean, "Animal Atlas" brings animals from around the globe into viewers' homes for an up-close look at how the animals live.

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth
programme.desc: If you're expecting this show to feature locations like Antarctica and the North Pole, you may be disappointed because the "coolest" in the title refers to how impressive a place is, not its temperature. Instead, the show explores the history and culture of cities and landmarks that are among the most astonishing sites on the planet. Each episode features three locations, showcasing the history, geography and traditions of each to help young people gain a better understanding of the diverse world in which they live.

programme.title: RaceWeek
programme.desc: Auto racing is one of the biggest spectator sports in America, with a number of organizations holding races nearly year-round so there's a lot to cover on "RaceWeek," which reports on the latest news from the racing world. Covering everything from NASCAR and IRL to Formula One and drag racing, the weekly show keeps viewers in the know with what's happening on their favorite circuits. In addition to offering the latest headlines, the show takes viewers behind the scenes to see what goes on with their favorite drivers, pit crews and team owners between races.

programme.title: The Outdoorsman With Max McNeely

Some of the locations Max and Buck have visited over the years include Siberia, New Zealand and Brazil with guests such as singer Barbara Mandrell, former wrestler and politician Jesse Ventura and pilot Chuck Yeager. It's not all fun and games for McNeely and his guests as the show also deals with environmental and conservation issues.

programme.title: Deadly Squatters
programme.desc: Eugene and Laura return home from vacation to find that two young siblings have taken up residence in their home, and have now claimed legal rights as squatters. Forced to share their home with two strangers, they must play their wicked games and survive psychological terror as the legal system takes its time.

programme.title: He Killed My Sister
programme.desc: When Malorie's sister, Monica, disappears, everyone around her tells her to grieve and move on. Determined to bring her justice, Malorie embarks on a search for the truth. But when she meets Tyriq, his motives may not be as pure as they seem.

programme.title: A Secret Lie in Love
programme.desc: Clarice and Chase Scott have the perfect suburban life on the outside. But, their marriage that was built on passion, has become a battlefield of deceit, infidelity and betrayal. Clarice finds solace in the arms of another man.

programme.title: Shuttered Secrets
programme.desc: When Trey's ex-girlfriend, Jada, unexpectedly shows up to his studio, she accuses him of dark secrets and being involved in a missing persons case. Their reunion quickly spirals into psychological warfare and violence. As the night goes on, the line between predator and victim blurs when other mysterious figures arrive and everything must be questioned.

programme.title: Untangled Mirror
programme.desc: J. Nicole is a determined mother, entrepreneur and hairstylist fighting to balance her personal and professional worlds while navigating love, family and the weight of false perceptions. By day, she runs her salon with pride, presenting herself.

programme.title: La tournée des champs S01 E10

programme.title: En route vers l'ouest S07 E09

programme.title: Mères Alpha S01 E11

programme.title: Cuisine Collective: une assiette santé, sociale et solidaire! S01 E05
programme.desc: On découvre comment concocter des repas sains, variés et de qualité avec un budget limité; chaque participant prépare trois recettes et repart avec des repas pour la semaine; on parle aussi d'inclusion sociale, d'autonomie et de sécurité alimentaire.

programme.title: Ça se passe au Salon S01 E04
programme.desc: Larry Tremblay Shannon Desbiens reçoit l'auteur Larry Tremblay pour échanger autour de son univers littéraire riche et percutant ; une rencontre captivante où l'écriture, les thèmes marquants et la singularité de son œuvre prennent vie au fil de la conversation.

programme.title: Le coin des auteurs S01 E11

programme.title: Nos artisans S02 E04

programme.desc: Luke and friends adjust to their new surroundings; Sigsby sizes up Nolan as a potential rival; Tim chases his only lead in the search for an ally.

programme.title: New Wave - Message in a Bottle
programme.desc: Inspired by punk's DIY energy and David Bowie, a new generation of outsider artists sparks a movement that becomes known as New Wave.

programme.title: For a Few Dollars More
programme.desc: In the Wild West, a murderous outlaw known as El Indio and his gang are terrorizing and robbing the citizens of the region. With a bounty on El Indio's head, two bounty hunters, Monco and Col. Douglas Mortimer, come to collect the prize. Upon their first meeting, the two men view each other as rivals, but they eventually agree to become partners in their mutual pursuit of the vicious criminal.

programme.title: Smurfs
programme.desc: When evil wizards Razamel and Gargamel take Papa Smurf, the Smurfs embark on a mission to the real world to save him. With help from some new friends, they must discover what defines their destiny to save the universe.

programme.title: Legally Blonde
programme.desc: Elle Woods (Reese Witherspoon) has it all. She wants nothing more than to be Mrs. Warner Huntington III. But there is one thing stopping him (Matthew Davis) from proposing: She is too blond. Elle rallies all of her resources and gets into Harvard, determined to win him back.

programme.title: Legally Blonde 2: Red, White & Blonde
programme.desc: Elle Woods (Reese Witherspoon) journeys to Washington, D.C., to have her say about animal rights, but is ignored by every politician she encounters and quickly learns that the White House can be even tougher to navigate than the Ivy League. Finally, Elle makes the acquaintance of sympathetic Rep. Victoria Rudd (Sally Field), who helps the young lawyer get her foot in the door of Congress. Unfortunately, Elle still has to convince the entire legislature to hear her out.

programme.title: An Officer and a Gentleman
programme.desc: Zack Mayo (Richard Gere), a new member of the U.S. Navy, has a bad attitude. When he signs up for the Aviation Academy, he is met with the strict leadership of Sgt. Emil Foley (Louis Gossett Jr.), who gives Zack a rude awakening in terms of relating with other people. Through Foley's guidance -- and an unexpected romance with Paula (Debra Winger), an outsider who hangs around the naval base -- Zack learns some tough lessons and discovers what he truly wants out of life.

programme.title: Varsity Blues
programme.desc: In West Canaan, Texas, high school football reigns supreme. When starting quarterback Lance Harbor (Paul Walker) turns up injured, the Coyotes' ruthless coach, Bud Kilmer (Jon Voight), must promote benchwarmer Jonathon "Mox" Moxon (James Van Der Beek) to lead the team in its quest for a divisional title. Suddenly thrown into the spotlight, Mox must deal with the pressure of carrying the aspirations of an entire town on his shoulders, as he struggles to pursue his own very different dreams.

programme.title: The Thomas Crown Affair
programme.desc: Bored billionaire Thomas Crown (Pierce Brosnan) decides to entertain himself by stealing a Monet from a reputed museum. When Catherine Banning (Rene Russo), an investigator for the museum's insurance company, takes an interest in Crown, a complicated back-and-forth game with romantic undertones begins between them. In an attempt to find out where Banning's loyalties lie, Crown returns the painting and essentially turns himself in, hoping that Banning's feelings for him will lead to an escape.

programme.title: Worldbreaker
programme.desc: A father hides his daughter on an island to keep her safe while he equips her for survival and the battles ahead.

programme.title: Flesh & Blood
programme.desc: After being hired for an aborted coup, a group of unscrupulous warriors is abruptly disbanded. One of the mercenaries, Martin (Rutger Hauer), is determined to get revenge on his dismissive employer, Arnolfini (Fernando Hillbeck). To carry out his plan, Martin abducts the lovely Agnes (Jennifer Jason Leigh), the intended wife of Arnolfini's son, Steven (Tom Burlinson). Soon Martin and Steven are locked in an ongoing battle to see who will ultimately win the hand of Agnes.

programme.title: Scared Stiff
programme.desc: Accident-prone busboy Myron Mertz (Jerry Lewis) and his suave nightclub-crooner pal, Larry Todd (Dean Martin), get caught up in both a gangland slaying and a mystery involving the comely Mary Carroll (Lizabeth Scott). She has just inherited an island castle off the coast of Cuba that her lawyer, Cortega (George Dolenz), insists is overrun with ghosts and zombies. Attempting to save Mary from a mysterious stranger who wants her dead, Myron and Larry sail with her to Cuba.

programme.title: The Package
programme.desc: Army Sgt. Johnny Gallagher (Gene Hackman) is reassigned after he angers Col. Glen Whitacre (John Heard) at a meeting of American and U.S.S.R. military types. Gallagher's new job is to shepherd detainee Thomas Boyette (Tommy Lee Jones) from Europe to the U.S. But when Gallagher loses track of his prisoner, he asks his ex-wife, a servicewoman with access to Boyette's background data, for help. As the chase leads Gallagher to Chicago, the intrigue ramps up in way he couldn't have imagined.

programme.title: Marathon Man
programme.desc: Thomas "Babe" Levy (Dustin Hoffman) is a Columbia graduate student and long-distance runner who is oblivious to the fact that his older brother, Doc (Roy Scheider), is a government agent chasing down a Nazi war criminal (Laurence Olivier) -- that is, until Doc is murdered and Babe finds himself knee-deep in a tangle of stolen gems and sadistic madmen. Even his girlfriend, Elsa (Marthe Keller), becomes a suspect as everything Babe believed to be true is suddenly turned upside down.

programme.title: Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: When a group of civil rights workers goes missing in a small Mississippi town, FBI agents Alan Ward (Willem Dafoe) and Rupert Anderson (Gene Hackman) are sent in to investigate. Local authorities refuse to cooperate with them, and the African American community is afraid to, precipitating a clash between the two agents over strategy. As the situation becomes more volatile, the direct approach is abandoned in favor of more aggressive, hard-line tactics.

programme.title: Hannibal
programme.desc: Seven years have passed since Dr. Hannibal Lecter (Anthony Hopkins) escaped from custody. The doctor is now at large in Europe. Mason Verger (Gary Oldman) remembers Lecter too, and is obsessed with revenge. Verger was Dr. Lecter's sixth victim, and though horribly disfigured, has survived. Verger realizes that to draw the doctor into the open, he must use someone as bait: Clarice Starling (Julianne Moore).

programme.title: Backdraft
programme.desc: Chicago firefighting brothers Stephen (Kurt Russell) and Brian (William Baldwin) have been rivals since childhood. Brian, struggling to prove himself, transfers to the arson unit. There he aids Don (Robert De Niro) in his investigation into a spate of fires involving oxygen-induced infernos called backdrafts. But when a conspiracy implicating a crooked politician and an arsonist leads Brian back to Stephen, he is forced to overcome his brotherly competitiveness in order to crack the case.

programme.title: Cop Land
programme.desc: When hotheaded Superboy (Michael Rapaport) accidentally gets involved in an ugly racially-motivated incident, his uncle Ray Donlan (Harvey Keitel), a corrupt New York City cop, attempts to sweep it under the rug by helping fake his nephew's death. The bungled cover-up leads to investigations by idealistic Internal Affairs officer Moe Tilden (Robert De Niro) and Freddy Heflin (Sylvester Stallone), sheriff of the suburban New Jersey town where Donlan and his fellow crooked policemen live.

programme.title: Judgment at Nuremberg
programme.desc: In 1947, four German judges who served on the bench during the Nazi regime face a military tribunal to answer charges of crimes against humanity. Chief Justice Haywood hears evidence and testimony not only from lead defendant Ernst Janning and his defense attorney Hans Rolfe, but also from the widow of a Nazi general, an idealistic U.S. Army captain and reluctant witness Irene Wallner.

programme.title: Downsizing
programme.desc: Mild-mannered therapist Paul Safranek and his wife, Audrey, decide to undergo a process in which scientists shrink people down to miniature size to live in small communities. The irreversible procedure allows the people to gain wealth and a life of leisure while helping to cut down on the consumption of natural resources. As Paul gets to know his new neighbors and surroundings, he soon learns that living in a tiny suburb comes with its own set of huge problems.

programme.title: Valkyrie
programme.desc: Col. Claus von Stauffenberg serves Germany with loyalty and pride but fears that Hitler will destroy his country if allowed to run unchecked. With time running out for Germany and the rest of Europe, von Stauffenberg joins a group of like-minded, high-ranking men who want to overthrow the Nazi regime from within. With everything he holds dear in the balance, von Stauffenberg becomes the trigger man in a plot to assassinate the evil dictator.

programme.title: Wildcat
programme.desc: An ex-black ops team reunites to pull off a desperate heist and save an eight-year-old girl's life.

programme.title: Some Kind of Wonderful
programme.desc: Keith Nelson (Eric Stoltz), an artsy high school outcast, tries to land a date with popular girl Amanda Jones (Lea Thompson) with some help from his tomboy best friend, Watts (Mary Stuart Masterson). However, his advances draw the ire of Amanda's snobby ex-boyfriend, Hardy Jenns (Craig Sheffer), who makes plans to get even. Matters are further complicated when Watts realizes she likes Keith as more than just a friend and tries to convince him to stop pursuing Amanda.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: Born with facial differences that, up until now, have prevented him from going to a mainstream school, Auggie Pullman becomes the most unlikely of heroes when he enters the local fifth grade. As his family, his new classmates, and the larger community all struggle to discover their compassion and acceptance, Auggie's extraordinary journey will unite them and prove you can't blend in when you were born to stand out.

programme.title: Rain Man
programme.desc: When car dealer Charlie Babbitt (Tom Cruise) learns that his estranged father has died, he returns home to Cincinnati, where he discovers that he has an autistic older brother named Raymond (Dustin Hoffman) and that his father's $3 million fortune is being left to the mental institution in which Raymond lives. Motivated by his father's money, Charlie checks Raymond out of the facility in order to return with him to Los Angeles. The brothers' cross-country trip ends up changing both their lives.

programme.title: The Institute - Double Cross
programme.desc: Luke and friends adjust to their new surroundings; Sigsby sizes up Nolan as a potential rival; Tim chases his only lead in the search for an ally.

programme.title: Secret Service
programme.desc: MI6 agent Kate Henderson uncovers an audacious plot involving Russia and an asset in the UK Cabinet; Kate's hunt for the mole puts her agent's life at risk.

programme.title: Harley Davidson and the Marlboro Man
programme.desc: In this action movie, tough biker Harley-Davidson (Mickey Rourke) teams up with his cowboy-hat-wearing buddy known as the Marlboro Man (Don Johnson) to help save the bar of a mutual friend. Enacting a plan to rob an armored bank vehicle, the two are surprised to find that they've heisted a massive shipment of a new drug. Soon the corrupt bank head, Chance Wilder (Tom Sizemore), sends trained killers to take out Harley and Marlboro, with the duo fighting for their lives.

programme.title: The Ladies' Man
programme.desc: Upon losing his lover, Herbert (Jerry Lewis) gives up women for good and seeks a fresh start by taking a maintenance position at what appears to be an ordinary Los Angeles boarding house. To Herbert's surprise, however, the building caters specifically to single women. He immediately resolves to quit, but landlady Miss Wellenmellon (Helen Traubel) and sweet tenant Fay (Pat Stanley) talk him into keeping the job. In no time at all, Herbert is mired in one comic disaster after another.

programme.title: Barefoot in the Park
programme.desc: In this film based on a Neil Simon play, newlyweds Corie (Jane Fonda), a free spirit, and Paul Bratter (Robert Redford), an uptight lawyer, share a sixth-floor apartment in Greenwich Village. Soon after their marriage, Corie tries to find a companion for her mother, Ethel (Mildred Natwick), who is now alone, and sets up Ethel with neighbor Victor (Charles Boyer). Inappropriate behavior on a double date causes conflict, and the young couple considers divorce.

programme.title: Sky Captain and the World of Tomorrow
programme.desc: When gigantic robots attack New York City, "Sky Captain" (Jude Law) uses his private air force to fight them off. His ex-girlfriend, reporter Polly Perkins (Gwyneth Paltrow), has been investigating the recent disappearance of prominent scientists. Suspecting a link between the global robot attacks and missing men, Sky Captain and Polly decide to work together. They fly to the Himalayas in pursuit of the mysterious Dr. Totenkopf (Laurence Olivier), the mastermind behind the robots.

programme.title: RoboCop
programme.desc: In a violent, near-apocalyptic Detroit, evil corporation Omni Consumer Products wins a contract from the city government to privatize the police force. To test their crime-eradicating cyborgs, the company leads street cop Alex Murphy (Peter Weller) into an armed confrontation with crime lord Boddicker (Kurtwood Smith) so they can use his body to support their untested RoboCop prototype. But when RoboCop learns of the company's nefarious plans, he turns on his masters.

programme.title: RoboCop 2
programme.desc: Cyborg Detroit policeman Alex Murphy is the sole officer on duty after the police force goes on strike against evil conglomerate Omni Consumer Products and its push to foreclose on the city of Detroit. Aside from dealing with the normal level of crime, Murphy must take on crime boss Cain, the spread of a dangerous new drug called Nuke and the attempt by psychologist Dr. Juliette Faxx to create another RoboCop using a hardened criminal.

programme.title: RoboCop 3
programme.desc: Greedy corporation Omni Consumer Products is determined to begin development on its dream project, Delta City, which will replace the derelict Detroit. To achieve this end, O.C.P. is employing armed forces to bully residents out of the city, under the guise that they are just doing their part to reduce crime and root out thugs. After RoboCop (Robert John Burke) joins the civilian resistance, he sustains severe injuries but recovers to battle advanced ninja robots developed by O.C.P.

programme.title: Quigley Down Under
programme.desc: Matthew Quigley (Tom Selleck) is an American rifleman who travels to the Australian outback to answer a help-wanted ad calling for a sharpshooter. When Quigley meets his employer, Elliott Marston (Alan Rickman), he's appalled to discover the job involves killing Aboriginal Australians. The two men fight, and when Quigley is knocked out, Marston leaves him and a local crazy woman (Laura San Giacomo) to die in a remote part of the Outback. They're rescued, however, and plot their revenge.

programme.title: The Magnificent Seven

With their lives in jeopardy, Emma Cullen and other desperate residents turn to bounty hunter Sam Chisolm for help. Chisolm recruits an eclectic group of gunslingers to take on Bogue and his ruthless henchmen. With a deadly showdown on the horizon, the seven mercenaries soon find themselves fighting for more than just money once the bullets start to fly.

programme.desc: Shona and John host at Larch Green Lodges in Langbank. Their guests are delighted by the sweeping views, but their hosting is blemished by a breakfast black pudding blunder.

programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: The B&Bers head for the Distant Hills Guest House in Spean Bridge, run by Dani and Cameron. The guests are blown away by the scenic views, but a dirty discovery leads to tears at feedback.

programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: The final visit takes the B&Bers to 18 Craigmillar Park in Edinburgh. The guests are impressed by host Craig's military precision, but their feedback leaves him in quite a huff!

programme.title: Four in a Bed

programme.title: 24 Hours in A&E

programme.title: 24 Hours in A&E

programme.title: The Emergency Ward

programme.title: War for the Planet of the Apes

programme.title: The Way, Way Back

programme.title: My Big Fat Greek Wedding
programme.desc: Family tensions arise after a woman (Nia Vardalos) falls in love with a man (John Corbett) who is not Greek.

programme.title: Smoking Tigers
programme.desc: Lonely 16-year-old Korean American Hayoung tries to hide her problematic family and lower-income background from her new wealthy friends.

programme.title: Nanny McPhee Returns

programme.title: Shazam!
programme.desc: Billy Batson is a streetwise 14-year-old who can magically transform into the adult superhero Shazam simply by shouting out one word. His newfound powers soon get put to the test when he squares off against the evil Dr. Thaddeus Sivana.

programme.title: Shazam! Fury of the Gods
programme.desc: When a vengeful trio of ancient gods arrives on Earth in search of the magic stolen from them long ago, Shazam and his allies get thrust into a battle for their superpowers, their lives and the fate of the world.

programme.title: Robin Hood

programme.title: Rampage

programme.title: Roadworthy Rescues - Great 8N
programme.desc: In need of a new riding lawn mower, Derek heads east to find himself a 1950 Ford 8N tractor; with a cracked engine block and a bees' nest for a battery, Derek will have to revisit his farming routes to make this implement operational.

programme.title: Vegas Rat Rods - Iron Man and the Mullet
programme.desc: Steve and the Welder Up crew have to get creative when they're tasked with building an iron-worker themed rat rod that doubles as a work truck; Justin makes a big mistake; Steve tries to flip a beat-up 1967 Coronet that he finds in a junkyard.

programme.title: Vegas Rat Rods - The Real Iron Man Revealed

programme.desc: Tony Angelo and Lucky Costa swap in a junkyard-fresh 5.3L on a low-buck drag project, the Bonemaro; they perform some critical upgrades along the way.

programme.title: Truck U - Finishing the Job D150
programme.desc: Truck U puts the final touches on a Dodge D150 from Two Guys Garage. From protection under the bed, sound and heat insulation, better stance and firmer steering, this truck will finally be exactly what the owner always wanted.

programme.title: Garage Squad - 87 Buick Grand National
programme.desc: Restoring a Grand National takes a hard left turn; a 1987 Grand National owned the road in the 1980s, but has fallen on hard times.

programme.title: Garage Squad - 68 El Camino
programme.desc: A 1968 Chevrolet El Camino requires new brakes, a vital engine refresh and exhaust work to get it back on the road.

programme.title: Garage Squad - 69 Charger
programme.desc: Time and storage take a toll on a 1969 Dodge Charger that has remained in its original owner's family since it rolled off the lot.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Widebody C10
programme.desc: Willie B and Kevin unveil an incredible wide-body C10 that could be their most ambitious project ever. The goal is to transform it into a 1,000-hp street machine, combining cutting-edge engineering, premium aftermarket parts and show-stopping style.

programme.title: Build for Off-Road - Body Swapped Chevy Part 2

programme.title: Faster With Finnegan - Wheelie Motorhome vs. Little Red Firetruck!

programme.title: Iron Resurrection - El Chili
programme.desc: Gary Hopper, a longtime friend of Joe, brings a '55 Chevy Bel Air to the shop; because this '55 has sentimental value to Gary's family, the pressure is on to do this build right; but missing pieces and a dented hood throw a wrench into the job.

programme.title: Iron Resurrection - Instant Classic
programme.desc: Joe Martin is excited to see a straight '63 Impala with a four speed and legendary 409 engine under the hood; the owner wants to keep it original with the main mods under the body, new frame, suspension and big wheels.

programme.title: Iron Resurrection - Mint Condition
programme.desc: A new customer, comes into the shop with an exceptional 1963 Cadillac; this car screams luxury but needs an upgrade; with Shane giving the MBC team creative freedom on the build, Joe gets to work on a plan; new engine, new wheels and a new interior.

programme.title: Iron Resurrection - Flaming '56
programme.desc: Return customer Lee Farris comes to Martin Bros with a 1956 Chevy Bel Air, his first car that he wants to bring back to life; the first thing Joe notices is the outdated flame paint job.

programme.title: Iron Resurrection - Chop Top, Part 1
programme.desc: Joe Martin loves to push the limits; when a customer rolls into the shop with a 1950 Mercury Coupe, Joe Martin knows he needs to chop the top.

programme.title: Iron Resurrection - Chop Top, Part 2
programme.desc: With the 1950 Mercury successfully chopped, the rest of the work can begin; the MBC team now has to marry the old roof with the new geometry of the newly chopped body; there are angles everywhere, and they are all out of whack.

programme.title: Iron Resurrection - Ramble On
programme.desc: Joe Martin gets some unusual cars coming through the door of his work shop, but when a customer from California arrives with a '63 Rambler wagon and tells Joe he can do what he wants with it, he decides to go to town with a radical custom job.

programme.title: Iron Resurrection - Brothers Nova, Part 1
programme.desc: Joe Martin loves Novas and his eyes light up when a new customer, Eric, wants him to customize a 1972 as a tribute to his brother, if they can find one; Shag and Amanda hunt down a '71, in what appears to be mint condition.

programme.title: Iron Resurrection - Brothers Nova, Part 2
programme.desc: Joe Martin and his crew are always under the gun, but their latest build, a '71 Nova, is well behind schedule, and they have a ton of work to do; Joe is really going to town on the metal work on this car, inside and out.

programme.title: Head 2 Head - 2018 Chevrolet Camaro SS 1LE vs. 2018 Ford Mustang GT

programme.desc: Jonny Lieberman and Jethro Bovingdon pit Chevy's and Dodge's modern-day muscle cars against each other on the burnout pad, a drift track, and the road.

programme.title: Head 2 Head - 2018 Jaguar XJR575 vs. 2018 Maserati Quattroporte GTS
programme.desc: Jonny Lieberman and Jethro Bovingdon take a classic trip from Los Angeles to Las Vegas in two full-size luxury cars, the 2018 Jaguar XJR575 and the 2018 Maserati Quattroporte GTS.

programme.desc: Jonny and Jethro visit the nearly 800 horsepower club. The Ferrari 812 Superfast and Dodge Challenger Hellcat Redeye might seem worlds apart on paper, but they are only separated by eight horsepower.

programme.desc: Comparing the McLaren 600LT, which features more power and less weight, against the Porsche GT3 RS to see if the 600LT can compete with the GT3 RS's performance.
